services.desc: Celebrate your wedding in a one-of-a-kind setting at The Leavitt Theatre, a historic wedding venue by the sea in Ogunquit, Maine. With space for ceremonies, receptions, and full wedding weekends, we offer a unique alternative wedding venue experience with full-service catering, craft cocktails, and a backdrop your guests will never forget.
